name: St. Godhrkar de Wange
source:
Five years after the story of Knell of St. Godhrkar, the Silent Act has plunged Promland — a land once renowned for its symphonies—into eerie silence.

Journey between two contrasting cities:
- Thalizac, an ancient holy city from the prequel, now suffocated under surveillance and oppression.
- Moarta, a cinematic city rising from chaos, where the dawn of "talking pictures" sparks another silent revolution...

At the crossroads of their destinies, you’ll unravel layered deceptions and unearth truths capable of reshaping the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596750/Elegy_of_St_Godhrkar/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《圣戈德卡丧钟》故事发生五年后，《沉默的行动》让普罗姆兰——这片曾经以交响乐闻名的土地——陷入了诡异的寂静。

两个截然不同的城市之间的旅程：
- 塔利扎克，前传中的一座古老圣城，如今在监视和压迫下窒息。
- 莫阿尔塔，一座从混乱中崛起的电影之城，“有声电影”的黎明引发了另一场无声的革命……

在他们命运的十字路口，你将揭开层层骗局，并发现能够重塑世界的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596750/Elegy_of_St_Godhrkar/]Steam[/url]]
